# Dribbble

> > Dribbble is the world's leading platform for discovering top designers and creative professionals, hiring talent, and showcasing design work.

Dribbble connects creative professionals with clients seeking design and development services. The platform offers designer marketplaces, project briefing tools, hiring solutions, and premium membership options to facilitate collaboration between creative talent and businesses worldwide.

## Core Platform

- [Dribbble Homepage](https://dribbble.com): Discover designers, get inspiration, browse jobs, and connect with the creative community
- [Designer Marketplace](https://dribbble.com/designers): Find and hire top design experts and creative professionals for your projects
- [Design Agencies Directory](https://dribbble.com/design-agency): Discover leading design agencies and creative studios available for hire

## Hiring & Project Management

- [InstantMatch](https://dribbble.com/instantmatch): Generate project briefs and instantly match with top design and development talent
- [Browse Project Briefs](https://dribbble.com/browse-project-briefs): Browse available project briefs and freelance work opportunities for designers
- [Hiring Guide](https://help.dribbble.com/articles/11083661): Complete guide to hiring on Dribbble covering requests, proposals, payments, and collaboration

## Account & Membership

- [Sign In / Create Account](https://dribbble.com/session/new): Login and account creation for accessing Dribbble's designer community and services
- [Dribbble Pro](https://dribbble.com/pro): Premium membership offering enhanced visibility, client leads, and professional opportunities
